capabilities: Attach threaded comments to selected text or code lines
Store comments as HTML comment markers in the Markdown file
Suggest edits as accept-or-reject cards instead of changing text
Format comment text and set highlight colors and underline style
Print comments in a margin column when exporting to PDF
disambiguation: Not a Notion integration; it copies Notion's comment look and keeps all comment data inside the note.
extras: Fork of Document Comments; the repository also ships an agent skill and a validation script for the comment format. No network, telemetry or accounts are used. A pre-release build can be installed with BRAT.
intentEvidence: This is a fork of Document Comments by Kyle McDonald (@kylemcd).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to comment on a passage of a note, so review feedback has to live outside the file.
